name: Credit spreads
summary: US high-yield spreads 3.40%, inside the 4% Watch line
state: The US high-yield option-adjusted spread was 3.40% on 3 Nov, inside the 4% Watch line, about 28bp wider than a month earlier and near its widest in a year (FRED). There is no sign of a broad credit squeeze as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Borrowing conditions for riskier companies remain open. Wider spreads would mean costlier credit for indebted firms; that is not happening as of 5 Nov.
rubric_hit: HY OAS 3.32% below the 4% Watch line

sources.title: FRED — ICE BofA US High Yield OAS (BAMLH0A0HYM2)

why: High-yield spreads show how much lenders demand to fund weaker companies — an early warning of defaults and credit crunches.
drivers: Default expectations, risk appetite, rates, private-credit stress, fund outflows.

rubric.alert: HY OAS > 6.0%, or widened > 200bp in a month.
rubric.watch: HY OAS 4.0–6.0%, or widened > 100bp in a month.
